milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because mining a birch_log block drops the birch_log item into the player's inventory. The player starts with zero birch_log (verified via sandbox /clear command returning 'No items found'), so this rule cannot be a false positive at initialization. The only way to obtain birch_log is by mining the birch tree in the scene.

Uses inventory_has because crafting an iron_axe at the crafting table places the resulting item into the player's inventory. The player starts with zero iron_axe (verified via sandbox /clear command returning 'No items found'), and no iron_axe exists anywhere in the scene. The only way to obtain one is by crafting it from 3 iron_ingots + 2 sticks at the crafting table.
